oneLiner: Make room for small creative experiments
body:
## Hero
Make room for small creative experiments. Pixel Garden is a synthetic creative-workbench example.

## Features
Collect an idea, build a small experiment, and share a note about what changed.

## Metrics
Three working stages: idea, experiment, reflection. No invented usage numbers or testimonials.

## CTA
See the example experiments.

## Footer
Pixel Garden. Fictional demonstration only. No live signup or commercial offer.
